context: Asuka guides Ren on applying research.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: academic guidance; vocabulary (相当/ざる/いただく/実践/与える) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 研究を、実践に活かしたいです。
lines.en: I want to apply my research in practice.
lines.style: earnest young student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 実践は、社会に影響を与えますよ。
lines.en: Practice gives an impact to society.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 相当な準備が、要りますか?
lines.style: curious young student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 相当の覚悟は、持たざるを得ませんね。
lines.en: You can't help but hold considerable resolve.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 助言を、いただけますか?
lines.style: polite young student voice, soft warm earnest throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: いただいた疑問に、ヒントを与えましょう。
lines.en: I'll give hints to the questions you raised.
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 実践で、人に希望を与えたいです。
lines.en: Through practice, I want to give people hope.
lines.style: resolved young student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: その志は、相当に立派ですよ。
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured closing clarity throughout
